Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, meaning guests who have stayed with Quest may have had personal information exposed — check your email for any notifications from them. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that a software product called N-able N-central is being actively exploited in Australia right now, so if your organisation uses it, alert your IT team immediately. Professional services businesses are also being reminded they face the highest volume of cyber intrusions globally.
